docs__orientation.description: Lean current-state orientation. Use a focused feature or subsystem group before reading broader source.
notes: TODO owns executable work and completion conditions.
APP_STATE owns shipped behavior; review.md is opened only for integrity-pass evidence.

workflow__context_bank.description: Portable context routing, validation, generation, and controller entry points.
notes: Exact files and explicit globs are the only path contract; bare directories fail.
Node.js 22 or newer is the canonical runtime.
Generation never truncates a file or writes when --out - is requested.

feature__theme_system.description: Persisted theme registry, Modern and Original SMF presentation, workspace labels, and visual behavior.
notes: Original preserves the old editor's simplicity and compact hierarchy, including quad view before model load.
Theme definitions own labels, panel copy, camera scale, and grid behavior; components should not branch on theme IDs.
design-qa.md owns the preserved-source comparison and final fidelity evidence paths.

feature__model_outliner_materials.description: Model-derived submodel rows, source texture thumbnails, material fallback, and preview/source isolation.
notes: Outliner summaries read registered source materials so viewport previews cannot hide source maps.
Raw SMF DataTexture pixels are downsampled into bounded previews; unsupported images fall back to material color.

feature__fbx_support.description: Binary FBX 7500 export, import compatibility, pre-save validation, and round-trip coverage.
notes: The bundled exporter is the implementation authority.
Exported bytes must re-import and preserve representative mesh, skin, bone, and clip structure before save.
The independent Blender-authored fixture is test-only; Blender 5.0.0 validates both the source asset and app-exported output, but this does not claim universal FBX compatibility.
FBX texture parse waits on its isolated loader manager; unavailable maps fail safe before render.

subsystem__smf_codec_worker.description: SMF worker protocol, structural validation, ownership transfer, cancellation, timeout, and startup fallback.
notes: Worker messages are untrusted values.
Canonical editor buffers are cloned before export transfer.
Abort is rechecked after handler setup and before postMessage; runtime worker errors do not silently fall back to the main thread.

subsystem__export_pipeline.description: Current-root conversion, SMF diagnostics, source-state preservation, and serialized save orchestration.
notes: One pure candidate builder must own pose, animation, and live-skin application.
Indexed runtime geometry is expanded to SMF triangle soup before worker validation.
All saves stay globally single-flight and freshness-checked.

subsystem__viewport_editor.description: Three.js viewport lifecycle, selection, transform controls, edit gestures, overlays, and layouts.
notes: Mount-owned listeners and controls require one explicit dispose owner.
Long-lived callbacks read current mutable state through refs.
Perspective and orthographic panes keep distinct directions and zoom while sharing one pan/focus target.
Animation actions bind only when the mixer root matches the current root; attachment applies one complete current playback intent.
Pending RAF handles are canceled through the shared zero-safe animation-frame guard.

feature__rig_ik_pose.description: Bone hierarchy, pose editing, rig transforms, endpoint editing, and bounded CCD IK.

feature__animation_authoring.description: Timeline interaction, selected-bone key editing, clip management, metadata, history, and browser ownership.
notes: useLoadModel remains the load/export integration owner; animation authoring actions are delegated to the tested controller contract.
Quadratic interpolation is preserved as SMF metadata and previews linearly in Three.js.

feature__skin_authoring.description: Skin paint state, brush indexing, auto-weight algorithms, history, exportability, and browser ownership.
notes: Brush queries use bounded spatial candidates and verify world-space distance before mutation.
Completed strokes and batch actions own one undoable snapshot transaction.
Weight preview is a non-destructive vertex-color display; original color attributes and material vertex-color modes are restored on disable/export.
Batch history comparisons use a mesh/vertex snapshot index rather than repeated linear scans.

subsystem__smf_format_and_fidelity.description: SMF parsing, serialization, coordinate conversion, rig fidelity, and malformed-input diagnostics.
notes: The TypeScript codec is the full structural SMF authority; native validation reports header/offset acceptance only.
SMF limits are centralized in smfBinary.ts and must be changed with focused malformed-input tests and APP_STATE documentation.
Tangent handedness is normalized at import and byte-packed at export so the fourth tangent component is not silently discarded.

subsystem__tauri_bridge.description: Tauri command adapters, native file dialogs and binary IO, Rust peeks, and native smoke coverage.
notes: Native file reads/writes are capped at 256 MiB and run through blocking-task adapters.
validate_smf is an envelope/header check; full structural validation remains in the TypeScript worker codec.

tests__quality.description: Verification contract, test inventory, shared browser fixtures, lint/type gates, and production-boundary checks.

tests__browser_shell_lifecycle.description: Browser shell, model load, async ownership, worker responsiveness, and native IPC flows.
notes: The Playwright config owns one build-and-preview server for the full suite.
Test titles remain stable after the domain split.
The unit runner discovers every src/**/*.test.ts file in deterministic order; adding a file requires no package-script edit.
Managed Windows Chromium launch can use the process-local RUSTSMF_PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE override; the path must be absolute and existing.

issue__verification_current_head.description: Current-head verification evidence, authoritative gates, and environment-only browser blockers.
notes: Historical current-head evidence is 55/55 browser cases, 2/2 strict visuals, canonical desktop-smoke green, and Blender 5.0.0 validation of app-exported FBX output; a later managed rerun reached all 55 bodies but failed only during browserContext.close teardown with spawn EPERM.

Bundled Chromium still fails before app execution with spawn EPERM in the managed process; current evidence uses a process-local approved system-browser executable and keeps the environment caveat separate from product results.

issue__smf_resource_contract.description: SMF resource, allocation, offset, numeric, string, and fidelity boundaries across browser and native paths.
notes: Keep limits broad enough for committed fixtures but fail closed before allocation or numeric coercion.
Any limit change requires focused malformed-input coverage and current-state documentation.

tests__browser_authoring_formats.description: Archived compatibility route for the former combined browser authoring/format pack.
tests__browser_authoring_formats.archive_note: Use feature__rig_ik_pose, feature__skin_authoring, feature__animation_authoring, feature__fbx_support, and feature__theme_system.
notes: Generated indexed GLB coverage must pass SMF triangle-soup conversion and FBX re-import.
Strict snapshots remain opt-in and live beside their owning spec.

subsystem__load_editor_orchestration.description: Load/export intent ownership, editor snapshots, candidate construction, and stable cross-component event contracts.
notes: useLoadModel keeps its public return contract while pure snapshots, codec tasks, and export candidates own focused policy.
Renderer and requestAnimationFrame ownership remain in ThreeViewport; mount listeners and TransformControls have explicit dispose owners.

subsystem__dev_process_lifecycle.description: Windows launcher ownership, npm resolution, preview-server startup, Tauri beforeDev cleanup, and orphan prevention.
notes: The launcher prefers the npm CLI bundled beside the active Node executable before falling back to PATH.
Playwright owns one build-and-preview server; independent test commands must not compete for port 5173.
Long-running Windows dev processes remain launcher-owned and recursively cleaned.

workflow__old_editor_reference.description: Archived GameMaker source and screenshots used only for deliberate parity research.
notes: Do not load the full archived source by default.
Use explicit file or screenshot globs only for a named parity question; the listed weight shaders are the selected-bone heat-map and paint-transport references.
